Charlotte Fall Open

 

OVERVIEW

The Charlotte Fall Open takes place October 2-4, 2026 in SouthPark Charlotte. It is a 5 round classical event with a $6000 guaranteed prize fund - $5,500 in the main event plus a free $500 Saturday evening blitz tournament.

 

All sections are US Chess and FIDE rated. There is a minimum rating of 1000 and registration cap of 140 players.

WHEN

October 2-4 or 3-4, 2026

3-day and 2-day schedules available

Beautiful Venue in the Heart of Southpark! Walk to Starbucks, Whole Foods and more!

ELIGIBILITY

  • Must be members of US Chess.
  • There is a USCF rating minimum of 1000 to enter, based on July US Chess ratings or a peak rating achieved between September 1 - October 2.
  • See events schedule for other options this weekend.

REGISTRATION

  • Online registration only - no on-site registration.
  • All registration closes 90 minutes before round 1 or when capacity is reached.
  • On-site check-in is not necessary.
  • Registration Cap: 140 players. The organizers reserve the right to accept entries past 140 players depending on specific space constraints.
